name: Spell Area
description: Applies (or forbids) auras in specific areas or zones, optionally restricted by quest state, another aura, race and gender. Used e.g. for zone-wide buffs and quest-phase auras.

fields.name: Area
fields.help: Zone or area the spell applies in, 0 = any area

fields.name: Quest Start
fields.help: The spell applies only when this quest has been rewarded (or is active, if Quest Start Active is set), 0 = no quest requirement

fields.name: Quest Start Active
fields.help: If 1, having Quest Start in the quest log (active) also satisfies the requirement, not only having it rewarded

fields.name: Quest End
fields.help: The spell no longer applies once this quest is rewarded, 0 = none

fields.name: Condition Id
fields.help: conditions.condition_entry the player must fulfil; when set it replaces the quest/race/gender checks of this row, 0 = none

fields.name: Condition
fields.help: Edit the condition tree that must be satisfied for the aura to be applied.

fields.name: Aura Spell
fields.help: Player must have an aura of this spell (must be a dummy/phase/ghost aura); negative value = player must NOT have the aura, 0 = no requirement

fields.name: Race Mask
fields.help: Races the spell applies to, 0 = any race

fields.name: Autocast
fields.help: If 1, the spell is automatically applied to the player while all requirements are met and removed when they are not; if 0 the spell is only forbidden outside the requirements
